args.final_thought:
Phase 3 (Audit module) is complete. Here's what was built:

**Source files** in `src/modules/audit/`:
- `audit.model.ts` — `AuditRecord` interface with `id`, `entityType`, `entityId`, `action` (imported `AuditAction` from `src/shared/types/index.ts`), `performedBy`, `changes`, `timestamp`, `createdAt`
- `audit.repository.ts` — `IAuditRepository` interface with `create`, `findByEntity`, `findByUser`, `findByDateRange`
- `audit.service.interface.ts` — `IAuditService` interface and `CreateAuditRecordDto` (mirrors `AuditRecord` minus `id`, `createdAt`, `timestamp`)
- `audit.service.ts` — `AuditService` class implementing `IAuditService` with constructor-injected `IAuditRepository`, input validation on `log` (rejects missing/invalid `entityType`, `entityId`, `action`, `performedBy`), sets `timestamp` to current time, defaults `changes` to `null`
- `index.ts` — Barrel export of all public symbols

**Tests** in `tests/unit/modules/audit/`:
- `audit.service.test.ts` — 15 tests covering all service methods with `jest.Mocked<IAuditRepository>`, factory function `makeAuditRecord`, and `jest.clearAllMocks()` in `beforeEach`, following the same patterns as the employee service tests

**Verification**:
- `tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors
- All 45 tests pass (15 audit + 18 employee + 12 shared/types)
